name: ID-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a PVI of R+13
Simpson is a well-funded incumbent with over $1.1M raised
model.rationale: Simpson combines a solidly Republican seat, incumbency, and a large fundraising edge over a minimally funded challenger, and markets give him roughly a 95% chance. With no polls or expert ratings to move the estimate, the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending in the district would be the first sign the race is competitive enough to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Eastern Idaho's second district is firmly Republican territory, and Mike Simpson has held the seat for decades. He enters the general election after easily securing renomination, with a large financial advantage: he has raised about $1.1 million and holds over $400,000 on hand, while Democrat Ellie Gilbreath has raised roughly $107,000. Minor-party and independent candidates are on the ballot but show little fundraising activity.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and money. Prediction markets price Simpson's chances at about 95%. The district's Republican lean and Simpson's incumbency make an upset unlikely, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty about the exact margin.
